fieldValues.title: WG Agent-supported editor
fieldValues.role_holder: Builder (agent:editor-builder), Reviewer (agent:editor-reviewer), Steward (agent:editor-steward); the owner is the parent role
fieldValues.authority: Decides itself and auto-merges any change that executes a recorded ruling, RFC or invariant and names it; in mode clear or complicated; within srs-web, srs-rust, srs, semanticops.com; with green gates; at most 10 delegated merges per cycle, and only while the group is not paused (2 consecutive unacknowledged cycle reports). Epic semanticops.com#29 (the epic record and this role are not related by any relation type: semanticops.com#29 is named here).
fieldValues.boundary: Escalates, one proposed decision each: any change that would make or change a ruling; Door 2 or Door 3; complex mode; a breaking CLI or payload change; a pin bump in another repo; anything that touches gates or merge rules; going over budget. Outside: new rulings and RFCs.
fieldValues.source_of_authority: Owner (delegation, once ratified by the owner's charter decision)
fieldValues.revisit_when: The epic semanticops.com#29 closes, or the owner changes the mandate.

createdBy.name: Orchestrator (drafting a charter for owner ratification)
